description: Convert a Hijri date 'YYYY-MM-DD' (1343–1500 AH) to Gregorian using the Umm al-Qura tables, with the weekday. COMPUTED, ±1 day versus the moon-sighted UAE date; data_confidence 'medium'. Example: {hijri_date:'1448-01-01'} → 2026-06-16 (Tue). Response always includes data_confidence ('high' = all dates officially announced/confirmed, 'medium' = something is estimated), estimated_items[], sources[] (official URLs) and data_version.
name: hijri_to_gregorian
title: Convert Hijri → Gregorian (computed)
